title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Japanese Derby. Yaeno Muteki exchanges greetings with Mejiro Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O before the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No one has much to say. There is so much tension in the air that it becomes hard to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki has watched her friends obsess over the Derby. She knows how much they want this win. But rather than be deterred, it has strengthened her own resolve to win.
